notes: אֶפֶס כִּי is fused to *notwithstanding*, headed on אֶפֶס as the morpheme carrying the lexeme; the competing reading gives the word to אֶפֶס alone and marks כִּי unrepresented (rules 8, 23, 30).
The *for* of *for thine honor* is the bare predicate nominal's own supplied preposition (rule 33); the עַל is unrepresented because its phrase is recast as the English subject (rule 40).
